name: Artaxerxes
bio: Artaxerxes, king of Persia, received a letter from Rehum, Shimshai, and other officials in Samaria accusing the Jews rebuilding Jerusalem of restoring a historically rebellious city whose completion would cost him tribute. After a search of the records confirmed Jerusalem's history of rebellion, Artaxerxes ordered the work stopped until he gave further command; his officials then forced the builders in Jerusalem to cease, and the temple's reconstruction remained halted until the reign of Darius (Ezra 4:7-24). His own later decrees reopen the story in detail further ahead.
